title: Coherence of the explicit free evaluation transitions
statement: Let $I$ be a small category in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and $D$ a coherent diagram of sites [def-per-coherent-site-diagram]. Let $Q_a\dashv P_a$ be the actual abelian inverse and direct images with the mate unitors and compositors of [def-per-varying-site-abelian-systems]. Fix $i\in I$ and $A\in\operatorname{Ab}(D_i)$. Put $E_j=\bigoplus_{t:j\to i}Q_tA$, with coprojections $\iota_t$. Define $\lambda_c:Q_cE_j\to E_k$ for $c:k\to j$ by the preserved coproduct universal property, with $Q_c(\iota_t)\lambda_c=\operatorname{comp}_{c,t}\iota_{c\mathbin{\gg}t}$ (written in Lean composition order). Then $\lambda_{1_j}=\operatorname{unit}_j(E_j)$ and $\operatorname{comp}_{a,b}(E_l)\lambda_{a\mathbin{\gg}b}=Q_a(\lambda_b)\lambda_a$ for $a:j\to k,b:k\to l$. Moreover, for every $a:j\to i$, $Q_a(\operatorname{unit}_i(A)^{-1}\iota_{1_i})\lambda_a=\iota_a$. These assertions include empty sums and arbitrary endomorphisms. All sums are the categorical coproducts of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Each Q is left adjoint to the stipulated P, so its images of the coprojections are a coproduct. Define lambda by that coproduct universal property; its equation on every summand is abelianFreeTransition_ι.

The direct-image comparisons satisfy the pseudofunctor pentagon and unit triangles on sections. Their adjunction mates satisfy the analogous laws. Test the identity and composition equations for lambda on every iterated image of a coprojection. Both sides select the same composite-arrow label; the mate pentagon and triangles identify the preceding maps.
Apply the defining summand equation to the identity summand and cancel the mapped inverse unitor using the other mate unit triangle. This proves the normalized identity-generator equation.

In the inherited refinement through the punctual/completion and derived-sections continuity tools, this is the free/cofree evaluation input for compatible varying-site resolutions. Here: the free arrow-indexed transition construction and its coherence checks.

lean.statement: theorem abelianFreeEvaluation_coherence (i : I) (A : D.abelianFibre i) : (∀ j : I, D.abelianFreeTransition i A (𝟙 j) = (D.abelianInverseId j).hom.app (D.abelianFreeFamily i A j)) ∧ (∀ {j k l : I} (a : j ⟶ k) (b : k ⟶ l), (D.abelianInverseComp a b).hom.app (D.abelianFreeFamily i A l) ≫ D.abelianFreeTransition i A (a ≫ b) = (D.abelianInverse a).map (D.abelianFreeTransition i A b) ≫ D.abelianFreeTransition i A a) ∧ (∀ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i), (D.abelianInverse a).map ((D.abelianInverseId i).inv.app A ≫ Sigma.ι (fun t : i ⟶ i ↦ (D.abelianInverse t).obj A) (𝟙 i)) ≫ D.abelianFreeTransition i A a = Sigma.ι (fun t : j ⟶ i ↦ (D.abelianInverse t).obj A) a)
